title.en: Yuto Morioka presented research on aircraft path planning
title.ja: 森岡悠斗が航空機経路計画に関する研究を発表

summary.en: Yuto Morioka presented the paper "Deep Reinforcement Learning-based Aircraft Path Planning Method for Low-Altitude Economy" (co-authored with Shikhar Varma, Tinghan Wei, and Mikifumi Shikida) at a conference held at the Hiroshima City University Satellite Campus.
summary.ja: 森岡悠斗が広島市立大学サテライトキャンパスで開催された学会で論文「Deep Reinforcement Learning-based Aircraft Path Planning Method for Low-Altitude Economy」（Shikhar Varma，Tinghan Wei，Mikifumi Shikidaとの共著）を発表しました．

en: Yuto Morioka presented the paper "Deep Reinforcement Learning-based Aircraft Path Planning Method for Low-Altitude Economy" at a conference held at the Hiroshima City University Satellite Campus on 14–15 May 2026.
The paper was co-authored with Shikhar Varma, Tinghan Wei, and Mikifumi Shikida.
ja: 森岡悠斗が、2026年5月14日・15日に広島市立大学サテライトキャンパスで開催された学会で、論文「Deep Reinforcement Learning-based Aircraft Path Planning Method for Low-Altitude Economy」を発表しました。
本論文は、Shikhar Varma、Tinghan Wei、Mikifumi Shikidaとの共著です。
